description:
Find a reusable verdict by reading the one verdict record for its gate and digest, so reuse never scans recorded runs.

## Background

`IssueStore::find_reusable_gate_run(gate_key, digest)` (`crates/jit/src/storage/mod.rs:272-291`) scans every recorded run and selects one with `domain::latest_gate_run` (`storage/json.rs:1483-1490`, `storage/memory.rs:938-946`). Gate evaluation calls it on `self.storage` (`commands/gate_check.rs:916`), outside the mutation image; the one-line `reusable_verdict` wrapper (`:1037-1043`) is deleted by the gate dead-code removal 86d3625d. Both integration-test `IssueStore` wrappers forward the method (`tests/fast_docs_templates/template_apply_atomicity_tests.rs`, `tests/fast_rules/local_rule_enforcement_tests.rs`).

Each reusable run now writes `gate-runs/verdicts/<gate-key>/<inputs-digest>.json` naming its issue and run, and a run loads by `(issue, run)`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Reuse reads the verdict record for `(gate, digest)` from the mutation image and loads the run it names. It reads no other run and no other verdict record, and a run that no verdict record names is never a reuse source.
- [hard] REQ-02: `IssueStore::find_reusable_gate_run` and its implementations, including both test wrappers, no longer exist.
- [hard] REQ-03: A test proves that reuse succeeds while every other run record and every other verdict record is unparseable.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
title: Gate reuse reads one verdict record
